basic_details.short_information: Government Medical College and Hospital (GMCH), Akola, Maharashtra, has released the GMC Akola Group D Recruitment 2026 notification for 101 Class IV vacancies. The recruitment includes Peon, Laboratory Attendant, Ward Attendant, Casualty Department Attendant, Outpatient Attendant, Watchman, X-Ray Attendant, Ayah, Blood Bank Attendant and Assistant Cook posts. Candidates who have passed Class 10 and meet the prescribed eligibility conditions can apply online. The last date to submit the application is 18 December 2026 at 4:00 PM.

content_sections.text: Government Medical College and Hospital, Akola, has advertised 101 Group D vacancies across two establishments. Of these, 19 vacancies are available at Government Medical College, Akola, and 82 vacancies are available at the associated hospital establishment. Candidates should check the detailed reservation annexures in the official notification before selecting their preferred post.

content_sections.heading: Am I Eligible for GMC Akola Group D Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Candidates interested in GMC Akola Group D Recruitment 2026 should first check their educational qualification, age, domicile and language eligibility. The following table summarises the main conditions specified in the recruitment notification. Can 10th-pass freshers apply? Yes. Candidates must satisfy all conditions specified in the official notification.

content_sections.heading: GMC Akola Group D Recruitment 2026 Educational Qualification
content_sections.text: Candidates must have passed the Secondary School Certificate (SSC/Class 10) examination from a government-recognised board or institution. content_sections.heading: GMC Akola Group D Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: The examination fee must be paid online through the application portal. Different amounts apply to open-category and eligible reserved-category candidates. The examination fee is non-refundable under the conditions specified in the official notification. Candidates must complete the payment process before 11:59 PM on 18 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: GMC Akola Group D Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection for GMC Akola Group D Recruitment 2026 will be conducted through a Computer-Based Test (CBT). Eligible candidates will be considered for the subsequent selection and verification process according to merit, reservation and applicable recruitment rules. The notification specifies that no oral interview will be conducted for the advertised Group D posts. The examination duration is 120 minutes. Questions will be based on the prescribed syllabus, generally at the SSC/Class 10 standard. The recruitment instructions include a mandatory time-bound group system for the computer-based examination. The paper will be divided into four groups, with 25 questions and 30 minutes allotted to each group. Candidates must complete the questions in the allotted group time before moving to the next group. Once a group's time is over, candidates cannot return to earlier questions from that group. Applicants should read the examination-day instructions carefully to understand the group-navigation restrictions. The recruitment notification specifies that candidates must obtain at least 45% of the total examination marks to be considered for inclusion in the merit list. Since the examination carries 200 marks, this corresponds to 90 marks. Obtaining the minimum qualifying score does not guarantee selection, which also depends on merit, vacancies, reservation rules and eligibility verification. When the examination is conducted across multiple shifts with different question papers, the recruitment authority may apply the normalization method described in the notification to account for differences in examination difficulty. Candidates should refer to the official notification for the detailed method and examination instructions.

Original documents must be presented during verification as instructed by the recruiting authority.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in GMC Akola Group D Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Government Medical College and Hospital, Akola, has announced 101 Group D/Class IV vacancies across its medical college and hospital establishments.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for GMC Akola Group D Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 18 December 2026 at 4:00 PM. The online examination fee can be paid until 11:59 PM on the same day.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for GMC Akola Group D Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed Class 10 (SSC) or an equivalent recognised examination and possess knowledge of Marathi. The other prescribed eligibility conditions must also be satisfied.

faq.question: Q4. Can 10th-pass freshers apply for GMC Akola Group D Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates who have passed Class 10 may apply without previous employment experience, provided they meet the required age, domicile, language and other eligibility conditions.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for GMC Akola Group D Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18–38 years for open-category candidates and up to 43 years for eligible backward-category candidates, calculated as on 17 November 2026. Other relaxation provisions apply to specified categories.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for GMC Akola Group D posts?
faq.answer: The advertised pay scale is ₹15,000–₹47,600 under Maharashtra Government Pay Level S-1.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for GMC Akola Group D Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The examination fee is ₹1,000 for open-category candidates and ₹900 for eligible reserved-category and EWS candidates. Ex-servicemen are exempt from the examination fee.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for GMC Akola Group D Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is based on a 200-mark computer-based examination, merit and applicable document verification. No oral interview is prescribed for these posts.

faq.question: Q9. Is Maharashtra domicile required for GMC Akola Group D Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes. The recruitment notification requires candidates to possess Maharashtra domicile, subject to the eligibility provisions stated in the advertisement.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I apply for GMC Akola Group D Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply using the official DigiALM registration portal. Applicants who have already registered can continue their application through the existing candidate login.
